option_relations.rationale: Ulcerative colitis is a type of inflammatory bowel disease, but it is not directly related to the dermatological symptoms described in the vignette.
Sweet's syndrome is a condition characterized by acute febrile neutrophilic dermatosis, which matches the symptoms described in the vignette.
Crohn disease is a type of inflammatory bowel disease, but it is not directly related to the dermatological symptoms described in the vignette.
IBD-associated neutrophilic dermatosis with ulcerative colitis is a subtype of neutrophilic dermatosis, which is related to the symptoms described in the vignette.
